about_the_game:
Take control of an abandoned laundry and try to win the recognition of the town's residents!

Clear the room of debris and arrange it as you wish. Buy washing machines, dryers, ironing machines and everything that will help you become No. 1 in this business.

Repair equipment, monitor the levels of liquids and powders in devices. Unlock new business functions such as dry cleaning, washing and others.

Improve your laundry room! Buy more equipment to attract more customers. Break down walls to increase the size of your space. Organize a waiting area to keep customers satisfied. Decorate the space to your liking by purchasing new items from stores.

Serve customers at the counter by selecting the services they need. Each customer has their own laundry requirements, and you must meet them. Ensure that all customers are satisfied with the service! Offer new services to earn more money. Hire staff to speed up business operations.

The laundry is a great place to sell additional items! Order the necessary goods from the store, set up shelves, and earn extra income from your business!

Key Features

  • ◆ Upgrade, manage, and expand your laundry

  • ◆ Serve customers according to their preferences

  • ◆ Create new services: clothing dry cleaning, shoe washing, selling goods, and more

  • ◆ Hire staff to automate the business

  • ◆ Monitor the functionality of the laundry and respond promptly to situations
